recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle interior photograph of a woman sitting on a white bed in a room with vertical wood-paneled walls. The scene is dominated by off-white and cream tones, featuring a sink, a closet door, and hanging white garments. The layout uses a dual-typographic approach with a clean sans-serif header and a vibrant red handwritten script overlay.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned in the lower-left quadrant against a stark white bed
Vertical lines of wood paneling providing a rhythmic background texture
High-contrast red script cutting across the upper-middle neutral space
Receding perspective through an open doorway in the center-left
coreInvariants: Monochromatic cream/white color palette for the environment
Wide-angle lens distortion creating a sense of space
Naturalistic, soft lighting from an unseen source

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Human subject is medium-scale, seated on the left side of the frame on a large bed.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white bed and the seated figure provide the primary weight in the lower half.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red script in the center, move down to the subject, then follow the vertical lines of the paneling and the sink on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper third and right side, occupied by wall texture and hanging objects.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm wood tones and shadows (doorway, floor)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red (primary text) and small floral pops (yellow/red near sink)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value, punctuated by a single high-saturation red element.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or neon colors
Limit palette to warm neutrals and one primary accent

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and casual cursive script
letterConstructionRules: Header: Wide tracking, uniform stroke weight, all-caps
Main Title: Rapid, thin-stroke handwriting with sharp angles and connected letters
The 't' crossbars are long and horizontal
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'h' and 't' have exaggerated vertical extensions
The 'g' has a sharp, straight descender

composition.relationshipToImage: floats in the upper-middle negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing between a rigid, spaced-out geometric sans and a fluid, energetic organic script.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top line
Hand-drawn quality of the main title
avoid: Centered alignment for the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean look of the top header
To capture the specific energy of the red handwriting

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photo of a woman in a white t-shirt sitting on a white bed in a room with vertical white wood paneling. A sink is on the right, and an open closet with white clothes is in the center. Muted, warm lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a top row of wide-spaced white sans-serif text. Below that, in the upper-middle area, add a large, energetic handwritten script in bright red.

verificationChecks: Is the red script legible but messy?
Is the top text extremely wide-tracked?
Does the room feel monochromatic and rustic?

adjustableVariables: Density of the wood paneling lines
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Spontaneous feel to the red handwriting

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red script does not look like a standard computer font.
Ensure the wide-angle perspective doesn't distort the human figure unnaturally.
Verify the color palette remains within warm creams and whites.
Confirm the top text is all-caps and widely spaced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a wide-angle rustic interior photograph with a dual-layer typographic treatment: a wide-tracked geometric header and a high-contrast, hand-drawn script overlay in a primary color.
